cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Logic Gets Bigger
cards.instruction: Use every new detail to expand the impossible system, its history, and the consequences of breaking it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Our meeting chairs float at noon. Book the ceiling; they've had landing rights since the furniture strike. I taught you floor plans; you're ready for ceilings.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can't we stand and tie the chairs down?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You always reached for string before asking me. Restraint broke the last treaty; that's when the desks joined in. Apply for an airspace permit.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The caretaker only issues floor permits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good, you've found the gap. Recommend her for altitude minister before the cabinets claim the roof. You can write the nomination without me this time.
